name: serine protease 8
pathways: positive regulation of sodium ion transport

function.text: PRSS8 encodes prostasin [Cleaved into: Prostasin light chain; Prostasin heavy chain]. Annotated molecular activities include serine-type endopeptidase activity and serine-type peptidase activity. It participates in protein processing and positive regulation of sodium ion transport.
